key_points: BMO Capital and Scotiabank both turning constructive on ENB after 17% decline from May highs, signaling potential mean-reversion opportunity.
Payout ratio hitting 148% raises sustainability concerns despite 31-year dividend streak and management reaffirming growth commitment.
Recently closed equity offering creates dilution overhang, while rising bond yields pressure the yield-sensitive valuation.
AI power demand narrative provides a supportive long-term tailwind for midstream infrastructure.
Much of the negative news (yield pressure, equity dilution, growth visibility) appears already priced into the 17% drawdown.
